title: Chapter 160: Four Parties Gather Together
content:
Chapter 160: Four Parties Gather Together

On the other side, Guangfu City, which had not been cleaned up yet, welcomed its first guest since its restoration.

"Welcome friends from the Goblin tribe!"

Wu Qing personally went out of the city to greet Gong Zhe who hurried over.

"It's an honor to meet you!"

Gong Zhe was very respectful and polite. Although he had never met Wu Qing, he had a deeper understanding of Wu Qing.

Wu Qing's personality in this world began to play a role. Gong Zhe was a person who admired Wu Qing very much.

"Nice to meet you!"

Wu Qing smiled. He really welcomed Gong Zhe's arrival. The Goblin Chamber of Commerce would not bring trouble like the Tengu tribe for the time being, but only benefits.

"Let's sit here and rest for a while and chat casually. There are two friends coming and need to be greeted."

Wu Qing invited Gong Zhe to the rest area prepared on the side. The two sat down. Compared with the size difference between Gong Zhe and Meng, Gong Zhe and Wu Qing sitting together were much more harmonious.

"Are they friends of the Tengu and Naga tribes?"

Gong Zhe was not surprised. He was going to establish a branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce in Mengzhong City, so he began to study the intelligence of the surrounding areas. His understanding of this area must be better than Wu Qing's.

"Yes, they will arrive soon."

Gong Zhe was not surprised that Wu Qing could control the intelligence dynamics of the nearby areas.

"Lord, before they arrive, we can just talk about the Chamber of Commerce and trade."

As soon as they met, they had the opportunity to be alone. Gong Zhe seized this rare opportunity to discuss topics such as the establishment of the branch, Zerg energy coins and the goods needed by the Zerg with Wu Qing.

He did not ask about the big explosion. Since Wu Qing said that he would wait for the three parties to arrive, he must talk about it together. It was not convenient to ask alone at this time.

Wu Qing said some of his own ideas and learned a lot about this world from Gong Zhe. The two sides chatted very happily.

With this friendly exchange, the friendship between the two sides was initially established.

Each has its own needs and demands. It is a need for interests and recognition of people.

…

The second team to arrive was the Naga tribe. Wu Qing had a deep understanding of the Tengu tribe's internal disputes, untimely responses, and procrastination.

The lower body of the Naga is a snake body, which is good at moving quickly on the ground. They have no legs to ride, so they are all infantry.

More than a thousand Naga warriors walked over, with a very strong momentum. Wu Qing felt that their strength was stronger than the bear goblin dragon cavalry.

"Welcome the Naga warriors!"

Wu Qing and Gong Zhe welcomed the arrival of the Naga tribe.

"Nagalong of the Naga tribe, thank you for the warm welcome from the human lord and the goblin friends!"

The leader of the Naga tribe, Nagalong, who was wearing double swords, came over and saluted Wu Qing and Gong Zhe.

He had a strong figure and a handsome face. Under the armor on his waist was a dark snake body covered with fine scales.

"The Tengu tribe will arrive soon. President Gong Zhe and I will wait here for a while."

"Warriors of the Naga tribe, you should go into the city and rest first."

Wu Qing said to Naga Long.

Gong Zhe is a businessman. Wu Qing has had contact with him through the Zerg host and knows his character. The two of them can chat and wait for others to get closer.

Wu Qing is completely unfamiliar with the Naga tribe. Wu Qing can see that Naga Long, the leader of the Naga tribe, is in a bad mood, so he arranges them to go into the city first.

Naga Long did not object and led the Naga warriors into the city.

Wu Qing and Gong Zhe stood and chatted for a few words, and the Tengu cavalry team arrived.

The Tengu cavalry that came this time was very powerful, and even the lizard mounts under them were very arrogant.

The first thing Wu Qing noticed was the old man of the Tengu tribe beside the two brothers Gou Yin and Gou Bao. This old man was the old man standing beside Gou Bao when Wu Qing first met Gou Bao.

Now looking at this old man of the Tengu tribe, Wu Qing felt that he was stronger than the three-star Zerg. Such a strong man has been following Gou Bao, the puppy-headed man, which shows that Gou Bao's identity in the Tengu tribe is really not simple.

Wu Qing estimated that the Tengu tribe sent such a lineup of cavalry this time because Gou Bao was coming.

Gou Yin had dealt with the Zerg several times, and his guard cavalry were all ordinary cavalry.

"Welcome friends from the Tengu tribe to visit!"

Wu Qing welcomed with a smile. Regardless of the relationship, basic etiquette is still needed.

Wu Qing saw the visiting teams of the Naga tribe and the Tengu tribe through the Zerg puppy, so he upgraded a three-star host again and flew here to take charge.

The spiritual power of the Queen of the Insects descended on the three-star host, and the deterrent power was amazing. Few people could tell its true and false.

He never underestimated anyone, not to mention that the two big tribes came.

With the three-star host in charge, there was no need to worry about these visitors causing trouble.

Gou Yin and Wu Qing exchanged pleasantries, and then they all went into the city together.

Gou Bao kept looking at Wu Qing curiously, but didn't say anything. Wu Qing just smiled at him and didn't take the initiative to say hello.

The three visiting parties finally arrived. Wu Qing arranged a meeting place in an attic next to the battlefield in the center of the city. Sitting in the attic, they could directly see the situation at the two explosion centers.

The Naga team that had gone ahead had already arrived. Naga Long was alone in the attic, staring at the two huge pits caused by the explosion.

Arriving at the bottom of the attic, Wu Qing invited Gong Zhe and Gou Yin to go upstairs.

Gou Bao, who was next to Gou Yin, saw this and quickly said: "Lord Wu Qing! When we meet old friends, you don't even invite me to go upstairs to rest!?"

Wu Qing smiled and said: "It turns out we are an old friend. You have changed so much that I didn't recognize you for a while."

"Since we are old friends, let's go upstairs together!"

Gou Yin took the initiative to introduce: "This is my younger brother Gou Bao. He is still young and a bit naughty. If I offend him in any way, please forgive me!"

Wu Qing took Gong Zhe, Gou Yin and Gou Bao upstairs together. The old man from the Tengu tribe followed Gou Bao upstairs.

Wu Qing did not stop this.

…

As soon as they went upstairs, Nagaron's voice rang.

"Do you Tengu tribe still need to come here?!"

When Nagaron saw Gou Yin, he asked sarcastically.

"You Naga tribe can come, why can't we Tengu tribe come?"

Gou Yin responded not to be outdone.

Nagaron didn't know much about the Zerg, and didn't know Wu Qing's identity. The conflict between the Tengu and Zerg was almost obvious, and there was no need to take Wu Qing's face into account. They ignored their master Wu Qing for some reasons. He had a direct fight with Gong Zhe next to him!

Wu Qing is very clear about his identity in this world, and does not care about the contempt of people from the outside world.

The big explosion caused by the insect queen attracted the attention of the two major tribes. It was not that the two major tribes were afraid, but that they wanted to understand the situation and be aware of it.

The true power of the Insect Queen's two attacks is unimaginable unless you experience it yourself.

It can be seen from the two people's contempt for Wu Qing that the two major clans still underestimated the threat of these two big explosions.

Wu Qing wanted to hear what conflicts there were between the two clans, and he immediately understood each other and refused to interrupt.

Because Gong Zhe was not the master, he could not speak out for Wu Qing, so he could only watch from the sidelines.

Gou Bao looked like he was watching the excitement, and the old man from the Tengu tribe beside him followed suit.

"You Tengu clan no longer retreat thousands of miles to protect yourself, but you go to the front line to care about the war?"

Nagaron said coldly.

"It's better than your Naga tribe being beaten by the enemy and asking for help everywhere!"

"If it weren't for your Tengu tribe, which couldn't even deal with bugbears, completely defeated the battle, and retreated thousands of miles, leaving our tribe vulnerable to enemies on both sides, how could our tribe be so passive?!"

"Our clan's territory at the foot of the Endless Mountains is weak. We admit that we are not like your Naga clan, who can't hold on and drag others into the water!"

"It's because there are so many races with no resilience at all like you that my local camp has been retreating continuously!"

Nagaron's next words instantly cleared up many doubts in Wu Qing's mind. Whether true or false, they are worthy of reference.

"I heard that your Tengu clan is preparing to escape from the world?! No wonder you abandoned your territory like a shoe!"

"Nonsense! Where did you hear the rumor?"

After hearing this, Gou Yin's face suddenly changed. He was really angry!

"Brother, don't talk nonsense to him. The master here is still waiting for us!"

Gou Bao pulled Gou Yin in time, interrupting the conversation between the two.

"You have something to say, don't hurt your kindness, please sit down!"

Wu Qing became the master of this attic, which was his first time here.

Gong Zhe could tell that Nagaron didn't know anything about the Zerg or Wu Qing, and the Naga were a fighting race with a very straight temper, which was why he provoked the incident just now.

He didn't want Wu Qing to have a bad opinion of the Naga clan, so he walked to sit down next to Na Jia Long, and introduced to Naga Long in a low voice: "Lord Wu Qing is the talker of the Zerg clan who just came into the world. , the territories of your two major clans are not far apart, and we will definitely have frequent contacts in the future."

"It's rare for a new race to join the local camp. You two major races should get closer and closer!"

The goblins are the vanguard against the invasion of the evil god camp. They travel as traders and often help resolve conflicts between local races.

When Gong Zhe saw that Nagaron was completely confused about the situation, he knew that he had other tasks. He came to investigate as a spontaneous act when he encountered an emergency, and did not know the relevant information in advance.

After listening to Gong Zhe's introduction, Nagaron immediately walked up to Wu Qing, gave a solemn salute, and respectfully said to Wu Qing: "Lord! I solemnly apologize to you for my previous disrespect!"

The title of a race that just entered the world is really useful. Anyone who knows the title of Zerg will immediately change their attitude.

Nagaron's contempt for Wu Qing is due to Wu Qing's positioning of himself, which can easily confuse people. As long as he shows a little momentum, others will not dare to despise him.

But because of this, he received an unexpected piece of news.

Wu Qing stood up, gave Najia Long a weak support, and said with a smile: "It doesn't matter, I think you are a temperamental person, you have anger in your heart, it's good to vent it!"

After learning that Wu Qing was the talker of a newly born race, Nagaron's attitude completely changed. Originally, he was just doing errands as usual, but he didn't expect an unexpected gain.
